target_text:
PROPER_NAME

10/16/2018

Have you ever keep making or do something but it always ends up in failure, well that will happen but if you are trying to do something that you really love than don't stop trying even if you fail at it. In a way people can feel like that failure can be used as a test on people.For example when someone is trying to do get something they want they have to able to earn that so when someone fail than they need to find a way to get around this failure and to keep going on his/her mission.

I do agree with this statement because when ledding to success, you need to know everyday that you went through all the the things you face that you kept going on your path and that you never stop going after what you want. The way failure works is by showing you that not everything is going to go your way and if things don't go your way also you need to stay full control of yourself because if you lose control of yourself than you are letting the failure turn into sadness with that inside of you feel like can't do anything this world so when that happens that is when you actually feel the worst kind of failure.

In a way failure can be a lession and I mean is by without feeling failure than what did you really learn from pursuiting to getting what you want. For example if I were to make a little mini rockect ship for school project and had two weeks to finsh it well with that I can feel like I will not finsh it and might fail it. The rockect ship I would start testing the if it can up in the air for a while than come down so I try to come up with ideas of how to to make it fly than I found a way and I'm so sure that this is going to work but it did not go as I plan it to be so here in this monent, this show me that I must figure out a different way to make it fly so to me it is important when you do something in life that you learn from your mistakes and to take that with tell people that I learn from my mistakes and that I never forget it.

In this world people would say it is lie that you don't need failure to have success and everyone has their own opinon on what is ture and what is not, but to me it matters on you, because it all matters on you the person and the reason why is each one of us is diffrent so eveything we do is diffrent. The way people will feel failure they can get it or not depend on what they are trying to get in life but in my opinon most of the people I know have every kind of failure and I never have met someone that has never felt failure in their lifetime of this world.

For this last one is me telling my own kind of failure and this kind of failure is in school. In school we have these tests we must pass and i'm not a big fan of it but you got to do what you need to do so these tests are every year and when they come around I tell myself that it is time to start study so for any normal person would do I start studying some of the things that learn from the whole school year and even make differnt ways to study them, for example I made flash cards but with all the help I got, when it came to the test I never seem to get it right and that was scary to me becasue I never understand why everything I was doing to parpere for this tests wasn't working but I didn't give up so went to ask for exta help on getting ready again for the tests. When the tests came up again, I told myslef that I'm going to pass and I did so when it happen I told myself that as long as just keep trying and I don't stop than I can do it.

In conclusion failure is something people are all going to feel it and for some of us it can take you to the deepest ends but all of us need to know no matter what happens that you will keep going on and you never stop until you get what you want and even if you keep failing and failing so what you are learning from your mistakes and when you figure out what is hold you back you learn from it than you never forget what you learn so that won't be a failure. In life you will fail but you need to know that it does not matter how many times you fail, but only matters how you take failure by taking it as a loss cause or taking as good thing and you keep moving forward and you get what you want in life. You have the power to pick what you do.
